stock_producer_evidence.semantics: Core forwards to AppleBCMWLANJoinAdapter::setKey at 0xffffff8001586450 with argument true and null auxiliary data. The setKey jump table distinguishes traffic keys, PMK/MSK (6/9), PMKSA (7) and password (10). Traffic keys map through mapAppleKeyToBcomKey, then runtime-selected async/sync firmware programming. External owner and completion contracts remain unresolved; see docs/development/NATIVE-CONNECTION-AUDIT.md.

join_adapter_dispatch.password_10: separate credential path, not a data-key install
join_adapter_dispatch.other_types: mapAppleKeyToBcomKey then firmware programming; mapping may reject unsupported types
join_adapter_dispatch.limitation: Producer dispatch reconstructed; caller state ownership and host-supplicant interoperability remain pending
